name: Book a flight
description: Given a request in words, book a flight that satisfies it. The first task with no rulebook: there is nothing to search through exactly, so looking ahead requires a learned model of how the world responds, and the gap between that model and reality has to be handled honestly.
notes: Success is a real outcome (the right flight was booked within constraints) and is verifiable but expensive, and mistakes cost real money. Needs the learned-model path in learning rule 5.
